categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu LiXing General Steel Ball Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of precision bearing rolling elements, including bearing steel balls and bearing rollers. The company serves various industries such as automotive (fuel and new energy vehicles), precision CNC machine tools, light industry and home appliances, robotics, wind power, engineering machinery, aerospace, rail transit, and heavy-duty equipment requiring high load capacity. It also produces ceramic balls and is expanding into high-end nitride ceramic rolling elements.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses internationally advanced core technologies and production processes for bearing steel balls, including ball blank heading, heat treatment, surface strengthening, resin wheel fine grinding, and multi-level non-destructive testing. For rollers, it has developed high-precision four-station cold heading, grinding, and environmentally friendly zero decarburization heat treatment technologies. It also focuses on intelligent manufacturing, digital management platforms, and automation with ABB robots and proprietary intelligent equipment. R&D projects include intelligent heat treatment, ultra-fine grinding for electric drive steel balls, high-speed cold heading, and ceramic ball hot isostatic pressing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include the global top eight bearing manufacturers such as SKF, GKN, JTEKT, and ILJIN, representing over 70% of the global market share. The company supplies to automotive, aerospace, wind power, precision machinery, and other high-end equipment sectors. It has established long-term stable supply relationships with major domestic and international bearing manufacturers and serves over 30 countries including the US, Germany, France, Italy, Mexico, Japan, and South Korea.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Jiangsu, Henan, Zhejiang, and overseas manufacturing facilities in the United States (South Carolina) and Mexico (Monterrey). It has a global sales network covering North America, Europe, and Asia, exporting to more than 30 countries and regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiangsu LiXing operates in the midstream of the bearing industry supply chain, specializing in the production of precision rolling elements (steel balls, rollers, ceramic balls) that are critical components for finished bearing manufacturers downstream. It procures high-quality bearing steel from upstream steel producers and supplies to global bearing manufacturers downstream.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes technological innovation and R&D to enhance product precision, durability, and noise reduction. Strategic priorities include developing high-end nitride ceramic balls, intelligent manufacturing, green production, and expanding global industrial layout. R&D focuses on intelligent heat treatment, ultra-fine grinding for electric drive steel balls, high-speed cold heading, ceramic ball hot isostatic pressing, and high-speed railway bearing rollers. It collaborates with the Chinese Academy of Sciences for advanced ceramic materials research.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of precision bearing rolling elements including steel balls, rollers, and ceramic balls. The company uses a direct sales model domestically and internationally, with pricing based on material, precision grade, and customer-specific requirements negotiated annually. It also engages in consignment sales and export sales under FOB, CIF, CFR, and DAP terms.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include Japan's Tsubaki Nakashima, Shandong Dong'e Steel Ball Co., Ningbo Haiyate Rollers, and Dalian Weiyuan Bearing Co. The company is the domestic leader in precision bearing steel balls, the only domestic enterprise in the global top eight bearing manufacturers' procurement system, and recognized as a national high-tech enterprise with numerous patents and awards. It holds a leading position in China and is expanding its global footprint.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.045 billion, a 4.29% increase from 2023. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 55.23 million, slightly down by 7.76%. Total assets reached RMB 1.913 billion, up 4.81%. The company maintains steady growth with increasing production volumes and expanding overseas operations. R&D investment accounted for about 5.32% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jiangsu LiXing offers high-precision, durable, and low-noise bearing rolling elements with international advanced manufacturing technologies and strict quality control. Its products meet or exceed international standards, supported by a comprehensive digital management system ensuring traceability and customization. The company’s unique value lies in its integration of advanced materials (including ceramic balls), intelligent manufacturing, and stable supply to global top-tier bearing manufacturers, enabling import substitution and supporting high-end equipment manufacturing.
